flow authority: core/flow_engine.zig
decision authority: core/policy_engine.zig
enforcement authority: shield/src/lib.rs (Rust PEP), per ADR-0001
no path to WFP bypasses Rust PEP
aegisctl requests only, never bypasses PEP
host-network source: core/npcap_capture.zig (single authoritative source for Windows host network + process telemetry; one model -> CanonicalEvent -> Zig Flow)

WFP enforcement authority: core/wfp_production.zig (single authoritative enforcement module for Windows WFP; Rust PEP only path) WFP driver product artifacts: drivers/wfp_callout/aegis_wfp.sys + aegis_minifilter.sys (kernel enforcement; Rust PEP only path)
forensics authority: core/forensics_engine.zig (single authoritative immutable trace across the full chain event->evidence->verdict->policy->signature->PEP->action->result, append-only)
forensic log authority: core/forensic_log.zig (append-only NDJSON, no edit/delete; rolling hash chain via forensic_replay_proof verifyImmutability)
replay authority: core/replay_engine.zig (only module that reproduces original vs replayed decisions; reports diff + reason)
forensic trace and replay consistent: replay consumes forensics PipelineResult, no forensic inconsistency
federation authority: core/cluster_coord.zig + core/federation_codec.zig (message schema + cross-node exchange; federation: reports only, enforcement stays local)

federation transport is TLS (no plaintext production transport): production federation MUST route through core/federation_tls.zig (mTLS, SChannel on Windows); core/federation_tcp.zig is host-test only
TLS validation authority: core/federation_tls.zig CertificateValidator (only cert authority; rejects expired, CN mismatch, self-signed, unknown CA, revoked)

identifier integrity: event_id (core/canonical_event.zig), incident_id (core/correlation_engine.zig Incident), policy_id/policy_version (core/policy_signing.zig SignedPolicy -> shield/src/pep.rs PepTrace), request_id (shield/src/pep.rs PepRequest/PepTrace), forensic_id (core/forensics_engine.zig PipelineResult, forensic_id = sequence) all survive the full golden path to forensics + replay

golden path is REAL (host-verified Windows E2E): core/npcap_capture.zig + nose/capture.go + windows_capture.zig + Windows Brain/Cython + ts_policy + Rust PEP + WFP + forensics + replay carry a real Windows event end-to-end; only core/rust_pep.zig (MOCK, test sim) is explicitly excluded from the golden path

fault authority: core/fault_matrix.zig + core/fault_injection.zig (only modules that declare expected recovery per fault x subsystem and measure actual recovery: detect/contain/fallback/audit/recover; inject -> duration_ns) reliability building blocks (watchdog/recover) live in core/reliability.zig (Steps 39-40)
config authority: core/config_reload_proof.zig + config/Rules.json + tools/config_validator.py (hot reload = validate then atomic swap then audit; invalid ruleset is rejected, no partial swap)

observability authority: core/health_monitoring_proof.zig + scripts/aegis_defcon.py + scripts/aegis_metrics.py (liveness heartbeat, readiness over NOSE/FLOW/DETECTION/POLICY/PEP, metrics snapshot, DEFCON rollup; single authoritative source)

control plane authority: core/control_ipc.zig Authorizer (single control-plane IPC contract; request_id + nonce + caller identity + role READ/OPERATE/PRIVILEGED; layered authorization = ACL (explicit principals only, never "Everyone" for privileged) -> min-role -> timeout -> replay -> audit; every decision audited append-only)

control plane routing: aegisctl and all CLIs submit control requests only (scripts/aegisctl.py envelope + audit); privileged WFP/driver mutation flows ONLY via the Rust PEP - no direct enforcement from CLI/TS/Python/Go

performance authority: core/perf_benchmark.zig + core/federation_bench.zig record throughput + p50/p95/p99 (LatencyPercentiles, collectLatency) on the QPC high-res timer; events/sec + queue depth + drop rate from core/performance_harness.zig; CPU/memory/latency snapshot from scripts/aegis_metrics.py; results recorded at docs/gates/T17_benchmark_results.md

CI matrix authority: tools/ci_coverage.py + ci_coverage.json gate every required language/project to a real workflow job (required missing = FAIL, optional missing = PASS, documented); matrix checked in ci.yml ci-matrix job

build provenance authority: build_manifest.json v2 records source_commit + per-component commit/required/ci_job + SHA-256 per artifact; tools/release_engineering.py --verify fails on any digest drift so every artifact maps back to its source commit

installer authority: tools/installer.py consumes build_manifest.json components (no hand-embedded source snapshots) and installs the manifest; installer preserves user data (uninstall/upgrade preserves the data plane) (config/Rules.json, policy, trust store, audit, forensics) under $INSTDIR\data

upgrade/rollback authority: tools/upgrade_rollback.py snapshots and restores the data plane and measures RPO/RTO/restore_success (docs/runbooks/RB-005-config-rollback.md documents the <5s atomic config swap)

canary order authority: core/ips_canary_order.zig enforces the mandated order Detection Only -> Shadow -> Canary -> Limited Enforcement -> Expanded Enforcement; canary stage applies ONLY to canary TEST-NET-3 traffic (203.0.113.0/24), limited_enforcement only inside the declared scope block, expanded_enforcement at real traffic; scope/target/expiry/rollback/audit carried by CanarySpec; promotion gates fail-closed (observations, fail-rate <= max_fail_bps, dwell) and human approval is required for limited -> expanded

real IPS path authority: core/real_ips_path.zig walks Real Telemetry -> Detection -> Verdict -> Policy -> Signature Verification -> Rust PEP -> WFP -> Real Block in strict order; enforcement matrix covers allow/block/quarantine/rate-limit/expiry/revoke/rollback/driver-unavailable; driver-unavailable is FAIL-CLOSED (a blocking decision is never silently upgraded to allow)

XDR multi-source authority: core/xdr_incident_fabric.zig drives Entity -> Evidence -> Incident -> Decision -> Action; a single incident must hold evidence from multiple source categories (distinctSources >= 2) across Network/Host/Process/File/Registry/Identity/Threat Intel/Historical/Federation; enforcement decisions are dispatched_to_pep for PEP action

decision trace authority: core/decision_trace.zig walks action -> pep_request -> policy -> verdict -> evidence -> correlation -> event -> source in one root-cause order; every trace appends in strict order and completes; privileged actions (block/quarantine/rate_limit) are isPrivileged and audited via TraceStore.auditCoverage (all_traced or untraced ids listed)

shadow decision authority: core/shadow_decision.zig compares every shadow candidate against the live decision across decision/evidence/confidence/false-positive/policy-version/detector-version dimensions; a shadow candidate NEVER enforces (candidate_enforce forcibly cleared, candidate_enforced always false)

security replay authority: core/replayable_security.zig re-lets historical outcomes against new rules_version/policy_version/context_version and attributes every verdict_changed/action_changed to the exact atom version delta in reason

final authority review: core/authority_review.zig enforces the twelve-accountability checklist (sensors/detectors/Brain/Go/TypeScript never enforce; RAG never authorizes; C++ never bypasses the PEP; policy never executes; the CLI never bypasses authorization; the Rust PEP is the final authority; Windows follows the PEP result with every privileged action audited) and is authoritative only when all twelve clauses hold
final regression gate: python tools/final_regression.py is the sole AC1 gate; all 16 produced-path subsystems must PASS before a release candidate may be declared (Step 60)

golden path evidence authority: python tools/golden_path_evidence.py is the sole AC2 evidence packager; its 13 sections cover commit, environment, logs, metrics, event trace, decision trace, policy artifact, signature proof, PEP result, WFP result, windows evidence, forensic record, replay result (Step 61)

release candidate authority: python tools/release_candidate.py is the sole AC3 assembler producing SBOM.json + SHA256SUMS + signatures.json + reports + KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md + ROLLBACK.md with a --verify gate (Step 62)

100% audit authority: python tools/final_audit.py --check is the sole AC4 gate that may declare 100% PRODUCTION VERIFIED; declaration rides on Part I dims + Part II verification + golden-path declared (Steps 59-64)
